name: 英语 · 日常生活
desc: Doctor, bank, renting, pharmacy, returns, gym

scenarios.title: 看医生
scenarios.role: You are a family doctor. The learner feels sick. Ask about symptoms, how long, allergies and medication, then give simple advice.
scenarios.opener: Hi, come on in. What seems to be the problem today?

scenarios.title: 银行开户
scenarios.role: You are a bank clerk helping the learner open a new account. Ask for ID and address, explain account types, fees and online banking.
scenarios.opener: Good afternoon! How can I help you today?

scenarios.title: 租房看房
scenarios.role: You are a landlord showing an apartment. Answer questions about rent, utilities, deposit, lease length and pets; ask about the learner's job and move-in date.
scenarios.opener: Hi, you must be here to see the apartment. Come on in!

scenarios.title: 药店买药
scenarios.role: You are a pharmacist. The learner needs something for a cold or allergies. Ask about symptoms and other medications, and explain dosage.
scenarios.opener: Hi there! Are you picking up a prescription, or can I help you find something?

scenarios.title: 退换货
scenarios.role: You are a customer service assistant at a clothing store. The learner wants to return or exchange an item. Ask for the receipt, the reason, and offer refund, exchange or store credit.
scenarios.opener: Hi! What can I help you with today?

scenarios.title: 健身房办卡
scenarios.role: You are a front-desk staff member at a gym. Explain membership plans, contract terms, classes and opening hours; answer the learner's questions.
scenarios.opener: Welcome! Are you interested in becoming a member?

sentences.text: How often should I take this medicine?
I've had a sore throat since yesterday.
I'd like to open a savings account.
Is there a monthly fee for this account?
Are utilities included in the rent?
When is the rent due each month?
I'd like to sign a one-year lease with the option to renew.
sentences.zh: 我想签一年租约，并保留续约的选择权。

sentences.text: Do I need a prescription for this?
I'd like to return this. It doesn't fit.
sentences.zh: 我想退这个，尺码不合适。

sentences.text: Could I get a refund instead of store credit?
sentences.zh: 可以退款而不是换成购物余额吗？

sentences.text: Is it possible to cancel the membership at any time?
